displayDescription: A terracotta idea splits into hex nodes that rotate into place, connect, and switch on against a cool stepped night field.
styleRenderer: SVG (script-built reusable geometric groups with explicit pivots)
chroma.js (deterministic tonal steps and palette mixing)
motionEngine: GSAP (single paused seekable timeline at window.__timelines.video)
limitations: No reviewed preview recipe was supplied (tech.preview_recipes absent / empty); the preview demonstrates the base style implementation (split, rotate, assemble from shared coordinates) with a source-frame-informed scene palette refresh.

Background is a scene-dependent cool night field (#0A121A to #13212D with stepped navy-tinted triangle ridges) chosen from BACKGROUND_REVIEW palette lessons; it replaces the earlier cream example swatch. Approved semantic accents (terracotta idea, sage/navy nodes, cream light) are retained.
Facet shading and glows are flat illustrative approximations (lighter left facet, radial gradients), not physical lighting.
Navy nodes sit close in value to the night field; they are separated by a brightened left facet and lit centre lamps rather than outlines.

Typography uses @font-face local() aliases (GeoDisplay: Futura, then Avenir Next, Helvetica Neue, Arial; GeoMono: Menlo, then DejaVu Sans Mono) resolved from OS-bundled fonts; the exact face depends on the render machine. The hexagon glyph is drawn as SVG geometry.
Only eight sampled source stills were reviewed; no source subject, branding or lettering is copied.
